Crop rectangle <code>(137, 616, 1286, 2223)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>2a76001ccaa9d997f4d0ee71fef03200918dba23193e7f653f38a0d7b156e492</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
